title: Aurora PostgreSQL15 DB on AWS Cloud RDS, dbaStanza HML
subtitle: Aurora PotgreSQL15 DB on AWS Cloud RDS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Aurora is compatible with PostgreSQL DB on AWS Cloud RDS.

It is a fast-emerging database in the DBA world.

Customers are considering using the Aurora PostgreSQL database instead of traditional RDBMS.

Many traditional, licensed databases managed On-Premises are getting migrated to Aurora PostgreSQL Databases.

Aurora DB is gaining popularity as it overcomes the limitations and shortcomings of using PostgreSQL in a traditional way.

Even Aurora PostgreSQL DB has extended benefits over using PostgreSQL DB directly on AWS Cloud.

This course provides in-depth knowledge of Aurora PostgreSQL DBs' prowess, features, and capabilities.

The exclusivity of managing the Cluster for the Aurora PostgreSQL database is the high point of this course.

Now, Aurora PostgreSQL database is offered with the dbaStanza initiative at DataSphere with the associated components to make You, the DBA, an SME - Subject Matter Expert in handling the Regular Database requirements or the Special Database Migration solutions.

Yes, Aurora PostgreSQL eLearning is offered as HML - Hybrid Mode Learning, an Unique, very special program that comprises Daily DBA Sessions - Online Live Guidance with Mohan Sir, which enables You to interact with him to get his Experience as Knowledge.
